title: RONALDINHO, 46, PLAYS 45 MINUTES IN SERIE C: 2,000 SHIRTS SOLD IN 48 HOURS
description:
Eleven years without a match. Then forty-five minutes for Ravenna.

Ronaldinho, aged forty-six, made his Ravenna debut this month. Ravenna beat Forli two-nil. He played about forty-five minutes and didn't score, so he's still on 299 career goals, one short of 300.

The numbers around it are wild. Two thousand R10 shirts sold in forty-eight hours at 129 euros each. His signed match shirt is on auction, with bids above seventeen thousand reais. The club's Instagram gained over two hundred thousand followers.

Antonio Cassano called it a clown show. Clowns get great ratings.
